command: set +e; echo '===KOERPERPFLEGE UNIT==='; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-koerperpflege.service; echo '===IMMUN UNIT==='; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-immunsystem.service; echo '===SHOW==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-koerperpflege.service -p ExecStart -p MemoryCurrent -p MemoryPeak -p TasksCurrent -p FragmentPath; systemctl --user show frankenstein-immunsystem.service -p ExecStart -p MemoryCurrent -p MemoryPeak -p TasksCurrent -p FragmentPath; echo '===STATUS==='; systemctl --user status frankenstein-koerperpflege.service --no-pager -n 20; systemctl --user status frankenstein-immunsystem.service --no-pager -n 20
